name: Bun Do refined salute
approval: The owner preferred the refined version over the compact version and found it recognizable at 24 pixels.
requirements: Keep the defined nose, eye, joined-paw salute and belt detail.
Use the same refined drawing at small sizes.
Use one flat color with opaque interiors and transparent cutouts.
Do not restore the rejected compact variant.

generation.history: The selected Dojo salute concept was refined to simplify the paws and belt. A subsequent edit restored the defined nose at the owner's request. Superseded generated images were removed at the owner's request.

rasterCleanup: Threshold native alpha at 50 percent, apply #245B48, trim and fit an 800-pixel bounding box on a transparent 1024-pixel canvas. This removed generated color variation and uneven interior opacity.
vectorization: Potrace 1.16, flat compound path, optimization tolerance 0.4. Rebuild with ../build.py.
